content_sections.heading: About APS Binnaguri
content_sections.text: Army Public School Binnaguri Cantt is a CBSE-affiliated private unaided school located at Binnaguri Cantt, Dist Jalpaiguri (West Bengal). It runs classes up to XII (Senior Secondary School).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Address the application to: The Principal, Army Public School Binnaguri Cantt, PO- Binnaguri Cantt, Dist Jalpaiguri (WB), PIN-735232. Put the application in a sealed envelope marked "Application form for the post of Vice-Principal, APS Binnaguri". It can be sent by post or delivered by hand. The application form is available on the school website, www.apsbinnaguri.org . Applications submitted through email will not be accepted. Only hard copies submitted by hand or by post will be considered. The school will not be responsible for any postal delay, and applications received after the last date will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Regular Masters Degree with 50% aggregate marks in CBSE notified teaching subjects (preferably being taught in Army Public Schools) from a recognized University/Institution. Regular Bachelor of Education with 50% aggregate marks from a UGC/NCTE recognized University/Institution. Adequate working knowledge of computers, MS Office and MS PowerPoint. PhD, M.Ed and minimum 3 years of administrative experience in a recognized CBSE school. 6 years of regular service as a PGT in any teaching subject in a recognized CBSE school, OR 10 years of combined service as PGT/TGT in any teaching subject in a recognized CBSE school, with minimum 3 years as a PGT in a recognized CBSE school. Minimum 35 years and maximum 45 years as on the last date of submission of application. The upper age limit for regular employees of Army Public Schools and ESM will be 55 years. For APS employees (PGT/TGT), only the experience and age criteria are required to be fulfilled.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Detailed Bio-data Copies of certificates and mark sheets Receipt of the online payment of Rs 250/- registration fee

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through panel interviews. Only candidates shortlisted on the basis of qualification, experience and other criteria as may be considered by the board will be called for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Online payment of Rs 250/- towards registration fee is required, and its receipt must be attached to the application form. No TA/DA is admissible. Applications received after the last date of submission will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for APS Binnaguri Vice Principal?
faq.answer: The application must reach the school by hand or by post latest by 16 December 2026. Applications received after this date will be rejected.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for APS Binnaguri Vice Principal?
faq.answer: A regular Master's degree with 50% aggregate marks in CBSE notified teaching subjects and a regular B.Ed with 50% aggregate marks from a UGC/NCTE recognized University/Institution, plus working knowledge of computers, MS Office and MS PowerPoint.

faq.question: Q3. What experience is required?
faq.answer: Either 6 years of regular service as a PGT in a recognized CBSE school, or 10 years of combined service as PGT/TGT with minimum 3 years as a PGT in a recognized CBSE school.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Minimum 35 years and maximum 45 years as on the last date of submission of application. The upper age limit is 55 years for regular employees of Army Public Schools and ESM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Online payment of Rs 250/- towards registration fee is required, and the receipt must be attached to the application form.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply by email?
faq.answer: No. Applications submitted through email will not be accepted. Only hard copies submitted by hand or by post will be considered.

faq.question: Q7. How is the selection done?
faq.answer: Through panel interviews. Only candidates shortlisted on qualification, experience and other criteria considered by the board will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay for the Vice Principal post?
faq.answer: Pay and allowance are as per AWES guidelines. No TA/DA is admissible.

faq.question: Q9. What must APS employees fulfil to apply?
faq.answer: For APS employees (PGT/TGT), only the experience and age criteria are required to be fulfilled.
